queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Portuguese first-party discovery identified SEDUH's public Geoportal and IDE-DF ArcGIS REST service. Layer 138 (Lote Luos) was inspected, its schema and CRS recorded, an exact WUP-point query returned zero features, and a bounded RA-XVIII query returned three anonymous ID-plus-geometry features.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official SEDUH page reachable; describes public GeoPortal lot/cartographic lookup.
Official SEDUH parcelment portal discovered; page exposes RA-XVIII Lago Norte as a filter, but no direct parcel API was needed after the IDE-DF service was found.
Public ArcGIS REST service metadata reachable; CADASTRO_TERRITORIAL and LUOS groups exposed.
Lote Luos layer metadata reachable; polygon schema, native objectid, fields, and EPSG:31983 recorded.

attemptedRoutes.route: layer 138 query at exact WUP point
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 with zero features; treated only as exact-point miss.

attemptedRoutes.route: layer 138 bounded query where lu_ra_luos=18, resultRecordCount=3, outSR=4326
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 GeoJSON with three full polygons and native objectids 7, 8, 16; response reported additional records beyond retained bound.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-15.7507845018991, -47.8822399881169] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The sample contains at most three polygons and properties contains exactly one canonical native identity field: id.
Native source attributes, source field mapping, and administrative filter provenance are documented here and in the city record, not retained in GeoJSON properties.
No raw unsafe owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or registration fields were requested or retained.
No registry/catalog/runtime configuration, global report, queue ledger, or another city's file was changed.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.

qualification.reason: A real public parcel polygon layer and stable native OID were verified, but independent serial adapter qualification remains required.

uncertainty: Lote Luos is an official urban lot/land-use layer and may not represent the complete legal cadastral or title registry fabric. Exact-point nonintersection is local evidence only.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for independent serial review and adapter qualification against the IDE-DF layer; do not treat this packet as source integration/admission.
